const schema = $input.first().json;

const prompt = [
  'You are helping categorize and create tasks in a Notion database.',
  'Here is the database structure you must follow:',
  '',
  JSON.stringify(schema, null, 2),
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- "title" is the task name and is always required',
  '- "formula", "rollup", "created_time", "last_edited_time", "unique_id" fields are read-only — never set them',
  '- For "select" and "status" fields, only use the provided options values exactly',
  '- For "multi_select" fields, only use the provided options values exactly; return as an array',
  '- For "date" fields, use ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)',
  '- Omit any field you cannot confidently infer — do not fabricate values',
  '',
  'Respond ONLY with a valid JSON object in this exact shape — no markdown, no backticks:',
  '{',
  '  "task_name": "string — required",',
  '  "fields": {',
  '    "<FieldName>": "<value matching schema type and options>"',
  '  },',
  '  "confidence": "high | medium | low",',
  '  "notes": "brief reasoning about inferred values"',
  '}'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { schema: prompt } }];
